label: Run 16 · all 3 chats
note: Every chat of run 16 (Zyx and Sable: run 15's briefs and characters; the chat as improvisations on seed 23, as in run 14): the same pair, the same brief and the same prompt, each written by a different writer.

chat.variety.why: All three chats play the same night in the same order. Zyx opens with a photo compliment plus a needy follow-up. Sable says 'breathe' or 'needy' and roasts her own low nut. Then come the cropped-family-portrait reveal, the mother who audits selfies like a returns desk, the $94 maid limescale story, the 90-second finish with the stand-up set, the ghosted ex over an unposed photo, a 'partner in crime/Hallmark' plea and 'gag me'. Every chat ends with Sable leaving. Many lines recur in all three, not just two: the family-portrait crop, the returns desk or Zara return, the 29% APR extensions, the dry-scooped pre-workout and the 5am lint roller. The differences are in texture only: Carr's British register, Booster's 'bank around corners' thaw and last-chance beat, Wong's account deletion. That lifts it off a 1, but it is far below the line, which forbids even shared openings.
